newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China '97 retail sales seen up 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China '97 retail sales seen up 17 pct.

text.p: China's retail sales of consumer goods were expected to total 2,870 billion yuan ($345.8 billion) in 1997, up about 17 percent compared with 1996, the People's Daily said on Monday.
Growth would be 10 percent in real terms after inflation adjustment, the newspaper said, quoting the ministerial-level State Planning Commission.
The newspaper attributed the forecast growth to a stable macro-economic environment, high economic growth and rising demand.
China's retail sales of consumer goods were 2,460 billion yuan in 1996, up 12 percent in real terms from 1995.
Inflation was one of the main conditions unfavourable to retail sales of consumer goods, the newspaper said.
